title: Fix: sim two-process shared-Redis test flakes under full make test (a sim child exits 1)
description: apps/sim/tests/test_sim_shared_redis.py::test_two_sim_processes_share_scenarios_and_reset line 123 assert (first.returncode, second.returncode) == (0, 0) failed with (0, 1) in the P08-T02c1 review run (2026-11-05, make test -n auto) and with (1, 0) during P08-FIX-7; passes 6/6 alone. All HTTP asserts passed, so one sim process exits 1 after serving (at or before SIGTERM shutdown). The child's stderr goes to DEVNULL: first capture it (file in tmp_path, shown on failure) to see the crash, then fix the cause in va_sim_server.main.run / SharedState shutdown (no retries).
